text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer tried to see off Aston Machan, 
who always headed to races alone, only to 
be called a workaholic. However, that 
wasn't the reason at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When told that they wanted to be by her 
side through major moments, she looked 
puzzled at first, but then replied with a 
simple, "I'm off, then!"
